title: Enchanted Cottage & Carriage House | Rosemary Beach Cottage | Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Two units combined creates a getaway for 17 guests. The Carriage House can give couples some privacy while the Cottage houses others in 4 bedrooms.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Since the first time humans set out to explore the land, there has always been something about the coast that draws our attention and captures our hearts, whether it be the deep blue ocean, banging its rhythmic beat upon the shore, or the fresh seafood that truly seems to be a stable of every restaurant. No matter what it is that draws us, make sure you satisfy that craving and bring the entire family, and those friends who might as well be, and stay at our lovely Enchanted Cottage & Carriage House!

The Cottage

Few offers can beat this two-for-one deal. Totaling 5 beds, 4 baths, and stretching a total of 3,836 square feet, this massive property can sleep a total of 17 guests, ensuring that nobody will have to be left out of the experience you have waited so long for. As you enter the cottage, you’ll notice the beautiful stone floors that stretch out across the living and dining area, as well as the kitchen. You’ll find that the cream-colored walls, large open windows, and the comforting décor truly make the place feel like a special home you’ve been gifted for a short time. You’ll find that the dining room is the perfect place for your guests to gather and feast under the elegant chandelier that lies above you, keeping watch over your party, as a crackling fire sits in the fireplace, embracing the room with flickering light. Further, you’ll find your kitchen is perfect for preparing whatever feast takes your fancy with custom cabinets, granite countertops, and stainless steel appliances. You’ll be able to prepare a feast that everyone will enjoy and be talking about for ages to come. Further, on the first floor, you’ll find the guest bedroom, complete with a walk-in shower.

As you climb the wooden stairs, you’ll find the other bedrooms sitting in wait for someone to call them home. You’ll find the master bedroom with its tall, vaulted ceilings, and its bath with a soaking tub and walk-in shower, making it the perfect sanctuary to rest. You’ll also find your guest bedroom, one of which comes with a comfortable queen bed, and the other with towering bunk beds perfect for any younglings that might have joined you on your adventure. Both will find that they have access to a private bathroom, ensuring that there will be no waiting when the need to get ready comes. As you walk to a window and gaze out, you’ll find your second home away from home in the Carriage House

The Carriage House

Nobody will complain about staying in this quaint and private home which features a bed and bath, as well as the ability to sleep a total of 6 guests within its welcoming arms. On the ground floor, you will find a private bedroom complete with a queen bed and television, perfect for a quiet night alone to watch whatever it is that takes your fancy. As well, you will find a cozy and welcoming living room, complete with a sofa bed should you need it. Not only this, but despite its small size you will find it comes with a fully functional kitchen able to rival any meal created in the main house. This gives your guests the ability to be with the family, but also have privacy when they need or desire calls for it. Further, your guests will enjoy the private patio, with an outdoor fireplace, perfect for sitting around at night as your guests tell stories of days past, as the firelight danced across their faces. Upstairs, you’ll find a lovely loft complete with two captains’ beds as well as a large window providing a beautiful view. As well, despite its size rest easily knowing that it comes with complimentary Wi-fi ensuring that no matter which of the two your guests stay in, they will receive the same welcoming luxury that is found in the main house.
So, if you are ready to take your family and friends out on a vacation they are sure to never forget, make sure you keep the Enchanted Cottage & Carriage House in mind, or even just rent one or the other, by contacting us at (866) 348-8952!

This property requires a 7 night minimum stay, Saturday to Saturday during spring break and summer and a 4 night minimum stay during shoulder season.
Pool can be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee.
